package migrated

import (
	foundryhttp "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
)

type User struct{}
type Reply struct{}

var (
	read     foundryhttp.AccessScopes[User]
	write    foundryhttp.AccessScopes[User]
	viewer   foundryhttp.Permission[User]
	editor   foundryhttp.Permission[User]
	endpoint foundryhttp.Endpoint[Reply]
	route    foundryhttp.Route[Reply]
	users    foundryhttp.GuardBinding[User]
	guard    foundryhttp.Guard[User]
	auth     *foundryhttp.Authentication
	audit    foundryhttp.Middleware
	redeemer foundryhttp.TicketRedeemer
	handler  = func() {}
)
